comment: Pinned upstream sources. scripts/vendor-sync.mjs fetches each commit and
copies the selected files into vendor/upstream/<name>/, preserving upstream
paths so the lock and the patches can be checked against upstream directly.
Everything is fetched with core.autocrlf=false, so the recorded hashes are
over the upstream bytes and reproduce on any platform.
No firmware, executable binary, captured TS or card data is vendored.

sources.name: libusb
sources.purpose: Official Emscripten/WebUSB backend and the core it needs.
selectionNote: Only the files the Emscripten build links. The other os/ backends
(linux, darwin, windows, haiku, sunos, netbsd, openbsd) are not
vendored. libusb-1.0.def is Windows DLL export plumbing and is not
needed either. config.h is generated at build time, not vendored.

sources.name: px4-userland
sources.purpose: PX-Q3U4 core: IT930x bridge, identity grouping, tagged TS demux, stream data plane, internal card backend.
selectionNote: The whole userland library is vendored rather than a subset, because
partially vendoring a C++ project with cross-includes is fragile.
pcsc_ifd.cpp and pcsc_ifd_adapter.cpp are present but are NOT compiled
into the browser build: the host PC/SC interface has no place in a
WebUSB client. Firmware is not part of this repository.

sources.name: libaribb25
sources.purpose: TS section parser, MULTI2 and the arib_std_b25 facade for M2.
selectionNote: b_cas_card.c is the PC/SC card implementation and is deliberately NOT
vendored; the card path goes through the Q3U4 internal reader instead.
Its interface and error headers are kept so the facade still links.
td.c is the standalone CLI and is not needed.
